title: 第九章 武者的特权
content_zh:
“严罗说的对！”江年看着罗峰，语重心长道，“罗峰你的进步速度很快，在我们宜安区极限武馆当中，你应该算是现如今进步最快的一个！16周岁进入我极限武馆，现如今18周岁，身体素质要求就达到武者境界。如果你去读大学，精力浪费在读大学上，浪费四年时间，那才是暴殄天物！”
“你要知道，16周岁到30周岁，是进步最快的，岁数越大，进步越难啊。”江年认真说道。
大学四年，的确是武者修炼最容易极速提升的四年。
浪费这四年去接受文化教育，在武者看来，的确是大罪过。
“呃……”罗峰有些发蒙。
老天，看来自己高考失败，也不算什么坏事嘛。
“罗峰啊，等你正式成为武者，加入我极限武馆如何？”江年微笑道，“只要你成为我极限武馆的武者，我极限武馆，会在最好的地方安排一套独栋别墅分配给你，当然，这栋独栋别墅你是不允许卖掉的。而且每月还有两万华夏币底薪。”
“独栋别墅？两万块底薪？”罗峰倒吸一口凉气。
两万块不算什么，可是独栋别墅就太奢侈了。
现如今整个华夏国，一共才六大人类基地，也就是六大市。土地是极度珍贵的，独栋别墅可是要缴纳巨额奢侈税的，现如今普通商品房都要几万块到十几万块一平方，这也导致绝大多数普通民众都是居住廉租房。
普通商品房就这么贵，叠加别墅、联排别墅、超大户型豪宅，一平方都要数十万华夏币的。
而独栋别墅，在如今这个时代，国家都是限制的，不是有钱就能住到的。有钱、有权、有特殊地位，才能住进去。并且还要将那巨额奢侈税，一般独栋别墅的价格，一平方肯定过百万的。
“一栋独栋别墅，就算小点，也有三百平方吧，也有两三亿了。”罗峰感到屏息，“虽然不允许卖掉，可是一家人住在独栋别墅里，那才算没到世上白来一遭啊。”
两三亿，什么概念？
就是张昊白的父亲，一个富豪，全部身家恐怕都赶不上这一套独栋别墅。
“罗峰。我极限武馆的福利，和加入国家特殊部门相比。也相差不大。”江年笑道，“国家部门的武者，有底薪福利，有居住特权，也就比我们多一个‘杀人执照’，可以根据形式临时决定杀死普通人。当然他们也不敢乱杀，回头还是需要和上面组织交代事情经过的。”
“杀人执照？”罗峰早听说过，国家特殊部门的武者的确拥有当场格杀人的权力。
“不过，我们极限武馆也是有特权的，如果哪个普通人惹了你，你可以上报给武馆，武馆查证属实后，会通过江南市安全局，直接将那普通人带走。”江年微微一笑，“加入我们武馆，金钱、地位，什么都有！你可以安心追求人类的极限，武道的极限！”
江年指向旁边的严罗：“我这位小兄弟严罗，就前不久猎杀一头怪兽，就赚了近一个亿的地球币，换算过来，就是三亿多华夏币了。你的天赋，好好努力，将来能够达到严罗这地步，也并非不可能。”
罗峰完全惊呆了。

老天……
猎杀一头怪兽，就赚这么多？到底猎杀了什么等级的怪兽？
“罗峰，好好努力。你的天赋真的很不错，别辜负这天赋。”江年微笑拍了拍罗峰的肩膀。
“小子，可千万别松懈，我相信你将来也是有可能，成为战将级武者的。到时候金钱、地位、美人。什么都有！”严罗微微一笑，“到时候，我可是很乐意和你一起出去猎杀怪兽的。哈哈……”说完，江年和严罗这两大武者笑着便离开了。
罗峰站在练武厅中，脑中乱的很。
不管是教官‘江年’，还是这个神秘的红发青年‘严罗’，罗峰都感觉到他们谈笑间中有着的一种肆意！一种张狂！
“肆意，张狂？”罗峰脸上渐渐浮起笑容，“对，男儿在世，就应该肆意闯荡一番，闯出一番事业来！世界第一强者就说过，不想当将军的士兵不是好士兵，不想当世界第一的武者，根本就没有武者之心！”
“人活一辈子，束手束脚，又有什么意义？”
“就要创出一番惊天动地的伟业来！”
18周岁，正是人生价值观逐渐固定的一个年龄，和教官‘江年’以及神秘武者‘严罗’见面后，罗峰心中想法完全变了。
“闯荡吧！”
“世界第一强者‘洪’，世界第二强者‘雷神’，分别创出极限武馆、雷电武馆。连五大强国，都要和他们平等以待。他们能做到……难道不能有第三个人做到？”罗峰微笑着朝练武厅外走去。
男儿有梦，有梦就去闯！
年轻就是资本！
年轻，就代表着未来不可限量！一切需要自己去努力，去奋斗！
××××××
6月28号，上午时分，天朗气清。
罗峰和魏文二人，正走在前往宜安区第三高中的路上，今天是领取毕业证书和志愿申请书的日子。
“阿峰，你真的有把我通过‘准武者考核’？”魏文忍不住惊呼道。
“嗯，7月1号，我就去扬州城的极限武馆总部――极限会馆，去那进行准武者考核。”罗峰微笑道。

前面已经是学校了。
罗峰看着前面的校园，看着校园内三三两两学生，觉得自己心态有些改变：“嗯？过去我将自己当成他们其中的一员，可是现在，我似乎感觉到，我和他们已经是两个世界的人了。他们上大学，以后努力工作，娶妻生子。”
“而我，和他们的道路不一样。”罗峰和魏文进入学校，分别去自己的班级。
走在教学楼走廊上。
“师兄。”
“罗峰师兄。”一些其他高三学生，还热情向罗峰打招呼。
“听说罗峰高考的时候，晕倒在考场呢。”
“真是可惜了，竟然在考场晕倒。”一些在远处看到罗峰的人，低声议论着。
罗峰的身体素质已经达到武者地步，听力非常好，清晰听到远处那些学生的议论。
高三（5）班，这是罗峰所在班级。
“罗峰来啦。”
“罗哥。”班级内不少其他同学已经到了，热情打招呼。
罗峰笑着点点头。
这些老同学和罗峰大多关系不错，也有部分比较不爽罗峰，表面上热情，不过其中还是有一些老同学却是在角落彼此低声议论着：“罗峰过去成绩那么好，又是武馆高级学员。没想到这次竟然跌这么一个打跟头，晕倒在了考场。真是运气不好啊。”
“这就是命，能怪谁呢？”
过去，罗峰就是班级中的天之骄子！
文化学习好、武力又强，现如今这位天才跌了一个大跟头，这些普通学生心中很自然会有一阵快意！虽然说，他们和罗峰交情不错，可是人就是这样。当看到过去优秀的人突然落魄，也会心中畅快，暗道――你也有今天啊！
“发毕业证书了，发毕业证书了。还有志愿申请书，大家都来领啊。”三名班干部捧着毕业证书、志愿申请书走上讲台。
“王尹。”
“刘夏龙。”

班干部在上面喊着一个个人的名字，发出毕业证书和志愿申请书。
“罗峰！”随着这一声，教室一下子安静了下来，几乎所有人目光都落在罗峰身上。
罗峰高考晕倒，大家都知道。
而罗峰的高考成绩，要知道身份证号、考试证号并非秘密，早有学生查过，知道罗峰的成绩，离本科线仅仅差四分。
“罗峰。”班长瞿琳将毕业证书和志愿申请书递给罗峰。
“阿峰，阿峰，走啦。”魏文正站在班级门口。
“等我一下。”罗峰随手一用力，嗤嗤～～～将志愿申请书捏成了纸团，随意一扔，被捏成纸团的志愿申请书直接丢入垃圾箱。
原本嘈杂的班级安静下来！
全班的同学们一下子愣住了，这可是高考填报志愿的申请书啊，谁敢扔掉？
顿时有一名麻雀斑女生惊讶喊道：“罗峰，你怎么把志愿申请书给丢了？你不填报志愿了？”
“罗峰怎么会肯去上专科，估计要复读，明年再考。”立即有议论响起。
站在班级门口的魏文，不由一瞪眼：“上专科学校？复读？你们也想得出来，阿峰马上就要去进行‘准武者考核’了，还上什么狗屁专科，还复读？”
“少说点，走吧。”
罗峰拉了魏文一把，和魏文一起离开了。
原本的班级的学生们顿时喧哗起来，什么？准武者考核？
“罗峰，他参加准武者考核？真的假的，不会这么厉害吧。”
“估计那魏文吹嘘的而已，罗峰去年成为高级学员，怎么可能今年就进行准武者考核。”
潜意识当中，这些学生们都不愿相信，罗峰达到武者的身体素质要求。
武者啊……
那是超然的存在啊。

――――
content_en:
"Yan Luo is right!" Jiang Nian looked at Luo Feng and said earnestly, "Luo Feng, you are progressing very quickly. Among our extreme martial arts gyms in Yi'an District, you should be the one who has made the fastest progress now! You entered my extreme martial arts gym when you were 16 years old. Now you are 18 years old, and your physical fitness requirements have reached the level of a martial artist. If you go to college and waste your energy on studying in college and waste four years, it will be a waste of money!"
"You have to know that the fastest progress occurs between the ages of 16 and 30. The older you get, the harder it is to make progress." Jiang Nian said seriously.
The four years of college are indeed the four years in which it is easiest for a martial artist to improve rapidly.
Wasting these four years to receive cultural education is indeed a great sin in the eyes of a warrior.
"Uh..." Luo Feng was a little confused.
God, it seems that failing the college entrance examination is not a bad thing.
"Luo Feng, how about joining my Extreme Martial Arts School when you officially become a martial artist?" Jiang Nian smiled and said, "As long as you become a warrior in my Extreme Martial Arts Academy, our Extreme Martial Arts Academy will arrange a single-family villa for you in the best place. Of course, you are not allowed to sell this single-family villa. And you will also get a basic salary of 20,000 Chinese coins per month."
"Single-family villa? Basic salary of 20,000 yuan?" Luo Feng took a breath.
Twenty thousand yuan is nothing, but a single-family villa is too luxurious.
Nowadays, there are only six major human bases in the entire Huaxia Kingdom, that is, six major cities. Land is extremely precious, and single-family villas are subject to huge luxury taxes. Nowadays, ordinary commercial houses cost tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of yuan per square meter, which has also resulted in the vast majority of ordinary people living in low-rent housing.
Ordinary commercial housing is so expensive. Stacked villas, townhouses, and super-large luxury homes cost hundreds of thousands of Chinese dollars per square meter.
As for single-family villas, in today's era, the state has restrictions, and it is not something you can live in if you have money. Only those with money, power, and special status can live in it. And after factoring in the huge luxury tax, the price of an ordinary single-family villa must be over one million per square meter.
"A single-family villa, even if it is smaller, is about three hundred square meters, and it is worth two to three hundred million." Luo Feng felt breathless. "Although it is not allowed to be sold, if the family lives in a single-family villa, then it is not a waste of time."
Two to three hundred million, what is the concept?
Zhang Haobai's father is a rich man, and his entire wealth may not be as much as this single-family villa.
"Luo Feng. The benefits of my Extreme Martial Arts School are not much different from those of joining the national special departments." Jiang Nian said with a smile, "Martial artists in the national department have basic salary benefits and living privileges. They have one more 'killing license' than us. They can kill ordinary people on a temporary basis based on the situation. Of course, they don't dare to kill indiscriminately. They still need to explain what happened to the superior organization later."
"Licence to kill?" Luo Feng had heard long ago that warriors from the country's special departments do have the power to kill on the spot.
"However, our Extreme Martial Arts School also has privileges. If an ordinary person offends you, you can report it to the Martial Arts School. After the Martial Arts School verifies the truth, the ordinary person will be taken away directly through the Jiangnan City Security Bureau." Jiang Nian smiled slightly, "Join our Martial Arts School and you will have money, status and everything! You can pursue the limits of human beings and martial arts with peace of mind!"
Jiang Nian pointed to Yan Luo next to him: "My little brother Yan Luo made nearly 100 million Earth coins by hunting a monster not long ago. When converted, it is more than 300 million Chinese coins. With your talent, if you work hard, it is not impossible to reach the level of Yan Luo in the future."
Luo Feng was completely stunned.
God...
Earn so much by hunting a monster? What level of monster did you hunt?
"Luo Feng, work hard. Your talent is really good, don't let it down." Jiang Nian smiled and patted Luo Feng on the shoulder.
"Boy, don't relax, I believe in youIt is also possible to become a general-level warrior in the future. When the time comes, money, status, and beauty will come. Everything! Yan Luo smiled slightly, "When the time comes, I will be happy to go out hunting monsters with you." Haha..." After saying that, Jiang Nian and Yan Luo, the two great warriors, smiled and left.
Luo Feng stood in the martial arts training hall, his mind very confused.
Whether it was the instructor 'Jiang Nian' or the mysterious red-haired young man 'Yan Luo', Luo Feng could feel the wantonness in their chats and laughter! A kind of arrogance!
"Wantful, arrogant? A smile gradually appeared on Luo Feng's face, "Yes, when a man is alive, he should be adventurous and have a career!" The strongest man in the world once said that a soldier who doesn't want to be a general is not a good soldier, and a warrior who doesn't want to be the best warrior in the world has no warrior heart at all! "
“What’s the point of living a life of restraint? "
“We are going to create something earth-shattering and great! "
18 years old is an age when life values gradually become fixed. After meeting the instructor 'Jiang Nian' and the mysterious warrior 'Yan Luo', Luo Feng's thoughts completely changed.
“Let’s make a splash! "
"The world's strongest man, 'Hong', and the world's second strongest, 'Thunder God', created the Extreme Martial Arts School and the Thunderbolt Martial Arts School respectively. Even the five major powers must treat them as equals. They can do it... couldn't a third person do it? "Luo Feng smiled and walked towards the outside of the martial arts training hall.
If a man has a dream, go for it!
Youth is capital!
Being young means the future is limitless! Everything requires your own efforts and struggle!
××××××
In the morning of June 28, the sky was clear and the air was clear.
Luo Feng and Wei Wen were on their way to Yi'an District No. 3 High School. Today was the day to receive their graduation certificates and volunteer applications.
"A Feng, did you really pass the 'quasi-martial artist examination' for me? "Wei Wen couldn't help but exclaimed.
"Well, on July 1st, I will go to the Extreme Martial Arts Headquarters in Yangzhou City, the Extreme Guild Hall, to conduct the assessment for prospective martial artists. Luo Feng said with a smile.
There is already a school in front.
Luo Feng looked at the campus in front of him and the students in twos and threes, and felt that his mentality had changed: "Huh? In the past, I regarded myself as one of them, but now, I seem to feel that they and I are already in two different worlds. They go to college, work hard, get married and have children. "
“But I’m on a different path than they are. "Luo Feng and Wei Wen entered the school and went to their own classes respectively.
Walking in the corridor of the teaching building.
"Brother. "
"Senior Brother Luo Feng. "Some other senior high school students also greeted Luo Feng warmly.
"I heard that Luo Feng fainted in the examination room during the college entrance examination. "
“It’s such a pity that I fainted in the examination room. "Some people who saw Luo Feng in the distance were talking in low voices.
Luo Feng's physical fitness has reached that of a warrior. His hearing is very good and he can clearly hear the discussions of the students in the distance.
Grade 3 (5), this is Luo Feng’s class.
"Luo Feng is here. "
"Brother Luo. "Many other students in the class have already arrived and greeted me warmly.
Luo Feng smiled and nodded.
Most of these old classmates have a good relationship with Luo Feng, and some are unhappy with Luo Feng. On the surface, they are enthusiastic, but there are still some old classmates among them who are whispering to each other in the corner: "Luo Feng used to have such good grades, and he is also a senior student in the martial arts school. Unexpectedly, I fell down so hard this time and fainted in the examination room. What bad luck. "
“This is life, who can blame you? "
In the past, Luo Feng was the pride of the class!
He is good at cultural studies and strong in martial arts. Now that this genius has suffered a big fall, these ordinary students will naturally feel a burst of joy in their hearts! Although they were on good terms with Luo Feng, people were like that. When I see someone who was outstanding in the past suddenly fall into decline, I feel happy and secretly think――You have today too!
"Graduation certificates have been issued. Graduation certificates have been issued. There are also volunteer applications. Come and get them." Three class cadres walked up to the podium holding graduation certificates and volunteer applications.
"Wang Yin."
"Liu Xialong."
The class cadre called out an individual's name and issued a graduation certificate and volunteer application form.
"Luo Feng!" With this sound, the classroom suddenly became quiet, and almost everyone's eyes fell on Luo Feng.
Everyone knows that Luo Feng fainted during the college entrance examination.
As for Luo Feng's college entrance examination results, you must know that the ID number and examination certificate number are not secrets. Students have already checked it and know that Luo Feng's results are only four points away from the undergraduate level.
"Luo Feng." Squad leader Qu Lin handed Luo Feng the graduation certificate and volunteer application form.
"A Feng, A Feng, let's go." Wei Wen was standing at the door of the class.
"Wait for me a moment." Luo Feng used his strength and pinched the application form into a ball of paper and threw it away casually. The application form was thrown directly into the trash can.
The originally noisy class fell silent!
The whole class was stunned. This is an application form for the college entrance examination. Who dares to throw it away?
Suddenly, a girl with sparrow spots shouted in surprise: "Luo Feng, why did you lose the volunteer application form? You didn't fill in the application form anymore?"
"Why would Luo Feng be willing to go to a junior college? He probably has to repeat his studies and take the exam again next year." There was a discussion immediately.
Wei Wen, who was standing at the door of the class, couldn't help but glared: "Going to a junior college? Repeating studies? As you can imagine, Afeng is going to take the 'quasi-martial artist examination' soon. What kind of bullshit junior college are you going to repeat?"
"Stop talking and let's go."
Luo Feng pulled Wei Wen and left with Wei Wen.
The students in the original class suddenly started making noise, what? Quasi-martial artist assessment?
"Luo Feng, he took part in the quasi-warrior assessment? Really or not? He can't be that good."
"I guess Wei Wen was just bragging. Luo Feng became a senior student last year. How could he take the quasi-martial arts assessment this year?"
Subconsciously, these students did not want to believe that Luo Feng met the physical fitness requirements of a warrior.
Warrior...
That is a transcendent existence.
――――
